title: The ownership check is in the wrong place
summary: A customer sent in a screenshot of somebody else's report. The controller has grown since the ownership check on it was written; put the check somewhere the next route cannot miss it.

checkpoints.title: Nobody reads somebody else's report
checkpoints.hint: Read all four routes before you fix any of them. The export route serves the same data as the one that is checked, and the list route hands out everybody's.

checkpoints.title: Nobody deletes somebody else's report
checkpoints.hint: A 403 that has already deleted the row is not a 403. The check has to run before the handler does, which is exactly what a guard is for.

checkpoints.title: Anonymous is 401, missing is 404
checkpoints.hint: 401 is "I do not know who you are", 403 is "I know, and no". Answer the first before looking anything up, or a stranger learns which ids exist from the difference between 404 and 403.

checkpoints.title: The check lives in one place
checkpoints.hint: @UseGuards on the controller rather than on each route. This checkpoint reads the metadata rather than the behaviour, because the point is that the route added next month is covered too.
